tour.title: Project Overview
tour.description: Moedah POS is a high-performance Point of Sale system. The README describes the tech stack (Go + Next.js), branching strategy, and project standards.

tour.title: Backend Entry Point
tour.description: The Go application starts in cmd/api/main.go — it loads configuration, connects to PostgreSQL, initializes all repositories/services/handlers, and starts the HTTP server.

tour.title: Configuration
tour.description: Environment variables are loaded via config.go. The app reads DATABASE_URL, JWT_SECRET, APP_ENV and more from .env files.

tour.title: API Routing & Middleware
tour.description: Chi router (router.go) defines all REST endpoints and applies middleware for auth, RBAC, logging, and store context.

tour.title: HTTP Handlers
tour.description: Handlers parse HTTP requests, validate input, call services, and return JSON responses. Each domain entity has its own handler file.

tour.title: Business Logic Services
tour.description: Services contain the core business rules. TransactionService (958 lines) is the largest — it handles POS operations, pricing, discounts, tax, and loyalty points.

tour.title: Domain Model
tour.description: Domain entities define the core data structures — Product, Transaction, User, Customer, Store. DTOs handle request/response serialization.

tour.title: Data Access Repositories
tour.description: PostgreSQL repositories implement the repository interfaces using sqlx. Each entity has a dedicated repo file.

tour.title: Database Schema & Migrations
tour.description: Goose migrations evolve the schema over 39 migration files — from initial tables through loyalty programs, expenses, and modular permissions.

tour.title: Frontend Architecture
tour.description: The Next.js 16 frontend uses the App Router with React 19. Pages live in src/app/, components in src/components/, and API calls go through src/lib/api/.

tour.title: Infrastructure & Deployment
tour.description: Docker containerization via Dockerfile and docker-compose.yml orchestrates the full stack (Go API + PostgreSQL). GitHub Actions runs static analysis.
